name: Modernise Announcement Ticker
author: Modernise My Business

sections.description:
Modernise Announcement Ticker shows announcements in a smooth scrolling banner. Add as many messages as you like and they scroll across one at a time, in order, then loop.

  • Messages with optional links and optional show-from / show-until dates (handy for events and closures).
  • Choose the position: very top of the page, fixed to the top or bottom of the screen, above the footer, below the footer, inside any part of your theme (such as the nav bar) using a CSS selector, or anywhere with the shortcode [mmat_banner].
  • Choose the banner and text colours, size, text size, bold text and an optional label badge such as “NEWS”.
  • Control speed, direction, the pause between messages, pause on hover, a pause/play button and an optional close button.
  • Show on every page, the home page only, or every page except the home page.
  • Accessible: screen readers get a normal list of messages, there is a pause button, and visitors who prefer reduced motion see messages fade in place instead of scrolling.
  • Works on desktop, tablet and phone. No external services and no tracking.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it from the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Settings > Announcement Ticker, add your messages, choose where it appears and set the colours.
sections.faq:
The banner does not appear at the top or above the footer.

Those positions use the standard wp_body_open and get_footer hooks, which some themes (especially block themes) do not provide. Choose “Inside a specific part of my theme” with a CSS selector, a fixed position, or use the shortcode [mmat_banner] instead.

How do I put it in my nav bar?

Choose “Inside a specific part of my theme” and enter the CSS selector of your header or menu (for example .site-header), then choose whether it goes at the start, end, before or after it. You can also place the shortcode in a header builder.

Do the dates work with caching plugins?

Messages are checked against the date when the page is built, so clear your cache after a start or end date passes if you use full-page caching.
